dedupe_keys.name: data for electrification and renovation in eu building decarbonization a multi model comparison

description: Ece Özer and colleagues publish processed results from five models of EU27 building decarbonisation. The January 2026 release compares FORECAST-Buildings, Invert/EE-Lab, Invert/Opt, PRIMES-Buildings and EDGE/REMIND-Buildings under six electrification, district-heating or hydrogen scenarios with two efficiency assumptions. CSV outputs cover electricity and heat shares, heat-pump capacity and final energy demand, including 2050 comparisons. Downloads are free. Zenodo and the README state CC BY 4.0, while GitHub’s licence classifier reports CC0; this discrepancy is unresolved. The data can compare transition assumptions across building-energy simulations, but do not include the five executable models or establish observed future outcomes. Country and model resolutions differ, and uncertainty was not independently quantified. No related catalogue parent explicitly covers this comparison. The README retains publication and DOI placeholders; files and calculations were not inspected.
licence: CC-BY-4.0 in Zenodo and README; GitHub metadata classify the licence as CC0-1.0
